rows.notes: The cited document is a narrative literature review (Section 2 'Material and method' describes a database search of Scopus, Springer Link, Science Direct, NAL and Google Scholar; Section 2.1 and Conclusion discuss limitations of the literature search). It reports no own data, experiment, survey or model runs. Its statements on UAV-based remote sensing improving crop monitoring, resource management and productivity (Section 5.1, Table 1) are synthesised from other work, not the authors' own results. Hence Q1 is 'no' and all subsequent questions are 'no'.
